# WhichRepo

> Local-first task router for microservices, polyrepos, monorepos, and coding agents.

Official repository: https://github.com/smallshellctw/whichrepo
AI installation checklist: https://github.com/smallshellctw/whichrepo/blob/main/AI_INSTALL.md
Documentation: https://github.com/smallshellctw/whichrepo/tree/main/docs

## Install

macOS/Linux:
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/smallshellctw/whichrepo/main/scripts/install.sh | sh

Windows PowerShell:
irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/smallshellctw/whichrepo/main/scripts/install.ps1 | iex

No Go, Node.js, Python, Java, SQLite, Docker, account, or API key is required.

## Initialize and configure agents

whichrepo init /absolute/path/to/workspace
whichrepo setup auto --workspace /absolute/path/to/workspace
whichrepo doctor --workspace /absolute/path/to/workspace

## Core commands

- whichrepo "task description"
- whichrepo index
- whichrepo dashboard --open
- whichrepo config show
- whichrepo mcp

## MCP tools

- route_task
- refresh_index
- list_projects
- workspace_status

Routing output is evidence, not authorization to modify code, commit, deploy, or access production systems.
